title: Code expressions as credential values: must not be flagged
summary: Assignments in Python, TypeScript, Terraform and similar whose value is a code expression, not a literal. Covers 6 inputs.
rationale: Reading a secret from settings or another resource is the safe pattern; the expression holds no secret.
